1 (Currently amended): An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, wherein said light source is positioned at a defined location on said handpiece.

10 (Currently amended): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site, wherein said light source includes a defined attachment mechanism ensuring proper alignment along the probe. 

12 (Currently amended): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil configured for attachment to a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, and further comprising an additional fastener configured for removably attaching said coil to said power cable.

19 (Currently amended): A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to secure said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable substantially parallel to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operation of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operation of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source. 

21 (Currently amended): The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including securing said coil around a power cable that feeds said transducer or generator. 

25 (Currently amended): An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil that is configured for attachment around a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener configured for securing said coil to the power cable.
